architecture: Write an offline single-clip browser video editor from scratch. All source comes from your responses. One classic deferred app.js, no libraries/frameworks. Shared global app state, shared ui DOM references, named complete functions. app fields: loaded, busy, duration, start, end, filename, objectURL, downloadURL, recorder, chunks, canvas, ctx, raf, cancelled, audioContext, audioSource, audioDest. ui keys match DOM IDs: fileInput, preview, playBtn, seekInput, startInput, endInput, titleInput, exportBtn, cancelBtn, downloadLink, status, timeline, textOverlay, clipLabel, durationLabel, progressLabel. Functions: setStatus, setBusy, formatTime, loadVideo, togglePlay, seekVideo, validateTrim, updateTimeline, updateText, prepareCanvas, paintFrame, exportVideo, initEditor. Use browser-native video/Canvas/MediaRecorder APIs only. app.start/end are seconds, not percentages. Imported media stays in browser; no uploads. Real export must encode canvas frames, optionally attach audio via Web Audio. Maintain exact shared names. No demo assets or fake successful controls.

Declare ONE global app object with architecture fields initialized, and ONE global ui object mapping every DOM ID to getElementById. loaded/busy/cancelled false, start/end/duration0, nullable recorder/URL/canvas/context/audio fields, chunks empty. Define setStatus(message,isError=false) updating ui.status.textContent and error class; formatTime(seconds) returns safe mm:ss with finite clamped nonnegative numbers; setBusy(flag) updates app.busy, disables fileInput/playBtn/seekInput/startInput/endInput/exportBtn while busy or unloaded, shows cancelBtn only busy, prevents interaction during export without disabling the video element programmatically. This is just state/helpers; no handlers, imports, init call or other features. Don't redefine app/ui in later parts.

Set preview.onloadedmetadata to update loaded/duration/start0/endduration, start/end/seek input values and seek.max in seconds, clipLabel.textContent filename, durationLabel formatTime(duration), hide downloadLink until new export, setBusy(false), setStatus Ready, call updateTimeline and updateText. parts.task: Define complete functions togglePlay() async and seekVideo(value). Use app/ui actual shared state. Guard unloaded/busy. togglePlay pauses if playing; otherwise if currentTime outside [app.start,app.end) seek to start, then await preview.play with error handling. Set playBtn label appropriately. seekVideo clamps numeric seconds within0..app.duration and sets preview.currentTime, calls updateTimeline. Do not define event listeners here; final init handles timeupdate and trim end. No new globals, video classes, exports or playback timers.

parts.task: Define validateTrim() returning boolean; parse ui.startInput/endInput numeric seconds and require finite0<=start<end<=duration. Invalid: setStatus error and disable exportBtn, keep previous valid app.start/end. Valid: update app.start/end, enable export unless busy, setStatus duration of selected clip, call updateTimeline. Define updateTimeline(): if no loaded media show truthful empty state. Otherwise use DOM createElement/textContent (safe filenames/text, no raw user HTML) to clear and render actual .timeline-ruler with duration, .track-row labelled Video and Text, .track-label, .track-lane. Video clip .video-clip absolute left/start divided duration percent, width (end-start)/duration percent, text filename and selected seconds; Text clip .text-clip exists only if titleInput has text. Each lane has .playhead at currentTime/duration percentage. Do not create IDs that duplicate controls; no fake sample footage. ui.seekInput.value updated from currentTime. Timeline click handler belongs to final init. No global app/ui redeclarations.

parts.task: Define prepareCanvas() using actual preview.videoWidth/videoHeight, require >0. Create offscreen canvas, width min(originalWidth,720), height rounded proportional ratio; get2d context, store app.canvas/app.ctx, throw descriptive errors if unsupported. Define paintFrame(): drawImage(preview,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height), then if titleInput nonempty draw centered white bold system-font overlay at x width/2,y height*.9; textAlign center, textBaseline middle, font max(14,round(width/30))px, dark shadow or stroke so visible; max text width90% canvas. This part only prepares/paints, no media recorder, loops, events or exports. Preserve shared fields.

parts.name: Encode WebM
parts.task: Define complete async exportVideo() ONLY, using existing helpers. Return if unloaded/busy or !validateTrim(). Check canvas.captureStream and MediaRecorder support; choose first supported MIME video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus then vp8,opus then video/webm. Clear cancelled/chunks, setBusy(true), hide old download, prepareCanvas. Await seek to app.start: attach one-shot seeked before changing currentTime; resolve immediately if already within .02; give timeout rejecting after5s. Paint first frame, canvas.captureStream(24). Try audio: lazily create AudioContext, createMediaElementSource(preview) ONCE, connect source to context.destination and a MediaStreamDestination, resume context and add its audio tracks to canvas stream. If audio unsupported continue with explicit silent-export status. Create MediaRecorder on stream, collect nonempty dataavailable blobs. onstop stops canvas video tracks (keep reusable audio destination track), cancels RAF, pauses video, resets play label; if cancelled clear blob and status Cancelled; otherwise create actual Blob chunks with recorder.mimeType, require nonzero bytes, revoke old downloadURL, createObjectURL, set downloadLink.href/download=clip-mini.webm, reveal it, setStatus Export ready with byte size and audio/silent info; finally setBusy(false), clear progress. onerror cleanly stop and show actual error. Start recorder BEFORE await preview.play(). A requestAnimationFrame loop paintFrame + progress percentage while playing; stop recorder when currentTime>=app.end-.025 OR preview.ended OR cancelled, set time to selected end. Cancel UI handler only sets app.cancelled; this loop owns stopping. Catch failures resets busy, stops recorder/tracks and reports error. No invented encoder classes, Node APIs, fake downloads of original, or new globals. Keep implementation concise and complete.

Keyboard Space toggles playback unless target INPUT/TEXTAREA/contentEditable, preventDefault; Escape cancels busy. Set initial setBusy(false), updateText and status Import a video to start. Add beforeunload revoking app URLs if present and cancelling RAF. Do not redefine any helper/state/functions. All DOM controls must really call defined earlier functions.
